items.title: Larry Ridley interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 10, 2003
items.q: He was an entertainer and he was a good friend of Eubie Blake. In fact Eubie Blake told me stories about how they met.

ctx.x: And your uncle was a musician?

Yes. He was an entertainer and he was a good friend of Eubie Blake. In fact Eubie Blake told me stories about how they met. Eubie was traveling through Indianapolis, Indiana and Eubie was kind of down on his finances. So he went to the local pool hall and he was an excellent pool shark. And he kind of played down his ability and he told these guys, “Yeah well I’d like to shoot a few rounds” and they set up the limits for whatever the wager would be. And so he proceeded to just kind of take it easy and then after…
